hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: In this variation, the shadow pair condition includes a coordinate scale factor k: nums[j] - nums[i] == k * (j - i).

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Rearrange the relationship to isolate terms for each index: nums[i] - k * i == nums[j] - k * j.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Track frequency counts of normalized values nums[i] - k * i and sum the combinations.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass frequency hashing using transformed key nums[i] - k * i.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Nested loops checking all index pairs run in O(n^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Frequency map holds up to n distinct values.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Generalizes arithmetic normalization with multiplier k.
